summary: iter68 STL→PNG thumbnail auto-renderer — 14/14 backend pytest PASS + frontend visually verified. Renderer unit tests (empty, corrupted, real STL) green — PNG output starts with \x89PNG magic bytes, ~107KB from a 64KB STL. Endpoint POST /api/community/files/{id}/render/stl-thumbnail: (1) STL-only bundle happy path returns 200 {ok:true, thumbnail_url, size_bytes>0}; PNG URL on R2 resolves with Content-Type image/png and valid PNG magic. (2) DB row stamps thumbnail_url + thumbnail_auto_generated=true (verified via public GET). (3) Idempotent 409 on second call with 'already has a thumbnail' copy. (4) DXF-only bundle → 400 'No STL in this bundle to render.' (5) Cross-maker (test-other-iter68 JWT) → 403 — iter67 _is_design_file_owner fix holds. (6) Buyer JWT calling render on maker bundle → 403. (7) Corrupted STL bytes end-to-end → 422 with friendly copy 'STL appears corrupted or unreadable. Try re-exporting from your slicer.' (8) Anonymous → 401. (9) Unknown file_id → 404. Performance: 64KB icosphere STL renders in 334ms (well under 5s budget). Frontend visually verified on /community → Design Files (no overlay blockage this run): 8 renders in 4/3 aspect ratio, 3 ✦ RENDERED ribbon overlays visible on auto-generated thumbs. Missing-thumb prompts + render buttons correctly gated by isOwner (count=0 for signed-out viewers — by design). Regression: file-variant-chip / file-prompt-missing-svg / file-generate-svg selectors from iter67 still present and working; download dropdown unchanged; /variants endpoints unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: stl_renderer.py imports trimesh + matplotlib at call-time (inside render_stl_to_png) rather than module-level — good choice for cold-start latency since /community hits don't pay this tax, only actual renders do. First render will be ~1–2s slower due to matplotlib import; subsequent calls reuse the cached module. If sub-second first-render matters later, warm the imports at FastAPI startup.

MAX_STL_BYTES=50MB and MAX_TRIANGLES=250k are sensible. The quadric_decimation fallback path (lines 70–76) is never exercised by the current tests — icosphere(subdivisions=3) has only 1280 faces. Consider a targeted unit test that decimates a >250k-triangle mesh to ensure the fallback path still works; today it's untested code.

community.py render endpoint wraps httpx fetch in `except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(502, ...)` — this surfaces raw exception strings to the maker ('Couldn't fetch source STL: All connection attempts failed...'). Same over-broad catch pattern as the DXF→SVG endpoint. Narrow to httpx.HTTPError + httpx.RequestError and use a friendlier top-level message.

Endpoint has no explicit `?force=true` query param (docstring mentions it as future work). Once a thumbnail is set, the only path to replace it is admin. Consider adding `force: bool = False` and a DELETE /render/stl-thumbnail for makers to regenerate after they improve their STL.

Frontend CommunityPage.jsx:699 `canRenderStlThumb = isOwner && allFmts.has('STL') && !file.thumbnail_url` is correct but silently hides the prompt the moment a thumbnail is generated — good UX. Minor: the '✦ rendered' ribbon only tells the maker this was auto-generated; there's no way to trigger a re-render via UI if they don't like the default view angle (elev=30, azim=-60). Add once the endpoint supports force.
